description: This file defines classes and templates for handling asynchronous completion callbacks, primarily for testing purposes within the Chromium project. It includes callback helpers, internal classes, and specific callback implementations for int and int64_t types, as well as a buffer release callback.

classes.name: TestCompletionCallbackBase
classes.description: Base class for testing completion callbacks, providing result waiting functionality.

classes.name: TestCompletionCallbackBaseInternal
classes.description: Internal class managing the result state and message loop for callback handling.

classes.name: TestCompletionCallbackTemplate
classes.description: Template class for handling asynchronous callback results, supporting pending status checks.

classes.name: TestClosure
classes.description: Class providing a closure that sets the result, used for testing callback invocation.

classes.name: TestCompletionCallback
classes.description: Concrete class for testing completion callbacks returning int.

classes.name: TestInt64CompletionCallback
classes.description: Concrete class for testing completion callbacks returning int64_t.

classes.name: ReleaseBufferCompletionCallback
classes.description: Callback class that ensures an IOBuffer is not referenced after callback execution.

methods.name: WaitForResult
methods.description: Waits for the asynchronous operation to complete and returns the result.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Returns the result if not pending, otherwise waits for completion.

methods.name: callback
methods.description: Returns a callback bound to set the result.

methods.name: closure
methods.description: Returns a closure that will invoke DidSetResult.

methods.name: SetResult
methods.description: Sets the callback result and updates internal state.
